## Integration development

::: {.callout-note .example-author-notes}
### For course authors

The Python, mathematics and Pyodide examples load the selected consumer branches on this same examples
page. Python, mathematics and Pyodide use the shared feedback adapters. [Exact source revisions for this build](resolved-repos.json).
:::



::: {.callout-note .example-author-notes}
### For course authors

All shared-feedback development and acceptance checks live in this repository's
`example.qmd` entry page and its topic includes. Add a new tab and topic include
for each subsequent integration.
Once an adapter works here, its changes can be propagated in a
separate consumer PR. Python, mathematics and Pyodide are the current consumer integrations.

For installation and copyable authoring examples, see the
[README and API guide](https://github.com/Erasmus-CTM/ctm-assessment).
:::

::: {.callout-note .example-author-notes}
### Page and exercise policies

This page loads `feedback/page.yml`. The first activity in each of the four
feedback integrations selects its existing `practice-feedback` policy, using
`feedback-policy="practice-feedback"` for text or
`#| feedback-policy: practice-feedback` for code. All policy settings remain in
YAML; the inline selector supplies only a name. The policy sets a common word
limit while preserving each integration's existing hint sequence.
:::
